# MakeAPost

> MakeAPost (https://makeapost.site) is a zero-storage, privacy-first Screenshot Studio and Multimodal AI Social Post Generator built for developers, indie hackers, and SaaS founders. Edit screenshots on a 70% HTML5 Canvas and generate tailored X (Twitter), LinkedIn, and Reddit posts in a 30% AI sidebar in one tab.

## Core Facts
- **Website:** https://makeapost.site
- **Founder & Operator:** Adarsh Jayprakash Mishra (India)
- **Contact Email:** adarshmishra70931@gmail.com
- **Pricing:**
  - **Free ($0/mo, auto-renewed monthly on Google Sign-In):** 3 image edits/day, 1 AI post per platform/day (X, LinkedIn, Reddit), default MakeAPost watermark.
  - **Pro ($7/mo):** 30 image edits/day (900/mo), 10 AI posts per platform/day (900/mo), Hide Watermark (Clean Export).
  - **Advanced ($15/mo):** 50 image edits/day (1,500/mo), 15 AI posts per platform/day (1,350/mo), Hide Watermark + Custom Brand Handle.
- **Sample Mode:** Built-in Code Snippet Sample and SaaS Analytics Sample use 0 image credits and 0 AI credits for unlimited free testing.
- **Privacy Architecture:** 100% client-side HTML5 Canvas editing; zero screenshots and zero generated post drafts are stored in any database.
- **Social Sharing:** Zero-token native web intents + device clipboard PNG copy (never asks for X, LinkedIn, or Reddit passwords or OAuth tokens).
